verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships an official Admin CLI, kcadm.sh, in the server distribution's bin directory. It scripts administration of realms, users, roles and clients, mirroring the Admin REST API. The server itself is also driven by documented CLI commands such as start-dev and the update compatibility command. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (e.g., machine-readable output modes or non-interactive auth guidance), only a single summary doc mention of kcadm, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's use.
